_comment: 496 tasks completed (IDs 1-496). Archived to TASKS_archive.jsonl. Next ID: 497.

name: Frontend: Robust focus trap check in video modal
done_when: videos.astro handleModalKeydown focus trap uses getComputedStyle check in addition to offsetParent for hidden element filtering. Prevents focus escaping via hidden dropdown items.

name: Frontend: Extract shared CSS to reduce duplication across pages
done_when: Common CSS patterns (container, back-link, header, modal, speed controls) are extracted to a shared CSS file (e.g. styles/shared.css). upload.css, videos.css, settings.css import it. Total CSS lines reduced. All tests pass, build clean.

name: Backend: Deduplicate generateID into shared location
done_when: The generateID() function exists in one canonical location (e.g. helpers.go or a shared package). db/db_auth.go imports and uses the shared version instead of having its own copy. All tests pass.

name: Chore: Archive completed tasks in TASKS.jsonl
done_when: All done tasks (IDs 376-468) are archived. TASKS.jsonl only contains the summary comment and non-done tasks. File size significantly reduced.

name: Bug: Chunk upload TOCTOU race returns 500 on concurrent duplicate chunks
done_when: CreateUploadChunk uses INSERT OR IGNORE (or ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING). Handler checks rows affected — if 0, treats as idempotent success (returns existing chunk info like the existing check does). Concurrent duplicate chunk uploads return 200, not 500. Test added for UNIQUE constraint handling. Backend tests pass.

name: Docs: Update PROGRESS.md — task 476 done, fix E2E count, compact recent work
done_when: PROGRESS.md: (1) status summary updated to 480 tasks completed. (2) E2E count corrected from 71 to 67. (3) Duplicate 'Pending Tasks' section removed. (4) Recent work section compacted from 390+ to 50 lines. Total count updated to '1501+ tests'.

name: Docs: Update TESTING.md E2E test count from 71 to 67 and backend from 600 to 602
done_when: TESTING.md reflects 67 E2E scenarios (not 71) and 602 backend tests (not 600). Total test count updated.

name: Backend: Handle chunk file Close() error as fatal in chunked upload
done_when: handlers_upload.go chunk upload handler treats destFile.Close() failure as a fatal error — removes the chunk file and returns 500 to the client instead of continuing with a potentially corrupted file. Backend tests pass.

name: Bug: Burn job handler swallows GetBurnJob DB error
done_when: handlers_video_burn.go burn handler returns 500 when GetBurnJob() fails instead of logging error and continuing. If DB error occurs, user gets clear error response instead of silently creating a duplicate burn job. Backend tests pass.

name: Bug: Subtitle ETag uses truncated SegmentsJSON (first 100 chars only)
done_when: handlers_video_subtitles.go ETag generation hashes the full SegmentsJSON string (or its full SHA hash) instead of only the first 100 characters. Editing any segment invalidates the cache correctly. Backend tests pass.

name: Bug: TOTP verify response schema mismatch causes 'API response validation failed'
done_when: Frontend TotpVerifyResponseSchema matches backend response (message, totp_enabled, recovery_codes). User can scan QR code and enable 2FA without validation errors. Tests updated and passing.

name: Bug: Session IP shows 127.0.0.1 — add CF-Connecting-IP header support
done_when: GetClientIP checks CF-Connecting-IP header (highest priority when TRUST_PROXY=true) before X-Forwarded-For and X-Real-IP. Sessions and security events record real client IPs behind cloudflared tunnel. Tests added for CF-Connecting-IP. Backend tests pass.

name: Docs: Update security event logging docs and deployment spec for journalctl
done_when: SECURITY_EVENTS.md and deployment.md explain how to verify security events are working. Service file includes LOG_LEVEL=info (or docs explain default). Scripts updated if needed. All documented commands verified to work.

name: Docs: Fix TOTP spec and schema drift — setup response missing fields, verify response missing recovery_codes in spec
done_when: specs/totp.md verify response includes recovery_codes field. TotpSetupResponseSchema includes uri and issuer as optional fields (matching backend). Frontend and schema tests updated. All tests pass.

name: Fix Zod schema drift: sessions, language hints, upload complete, and user schemas
done_when: SessionSchema uses expires_at (not last_used_at). LanguageHintsResponseSchema uses suggested_language/suggested_confidence (not recommended). LanguageHintSchema includes language_name and raw_value. UploadCompleteResponseSchema uses upload_id (not id) and language_hints as DetectionResult object (not array). UserSchema includes email_verified. All tests updated and passing.

name: Docs: Fix API.md registration response to match actual backend response
done_when: API.md register response shows actual backend response shape (message, email_verification, user with email_verified). Removed false email-disabled alternative response that was never implemented.

name: Fix frontend type drift: TranscriptionStatus embedded_subtitles, BurnStatus duration/eta, AlignmentResponse conversion failures
done_when: TranscriptionStatusResponseSchema includes embedded_subtitles. BurnStatusResponse interface includes duration and estimated_remaining_seconds. AlignmentResponse includes conversion_failed_indices. Tests added. Build passes.

name: Bug: assembleChunks destFile.Close() error not fatal — could leave corrupted assembled file
done_when: assembleChunks treats destFile.Close() failure as fatal error: removes the partial file, returns error instead of silently continuing with potentially corrupted data. Backend tests pass.

name: Bug: Transcribe handler swallows GetTranscription DB error
done_when: handlers_transcribe.go transcribe handler returns 500 when GetTranscription() fails instead of logging and continuing. Prevents starting duplicate transcription or missing processing state on DB errors. Backend tests pass.

name: Bug: Burn status silently discards GetTranscription error
done_when: handlers_video_burn.go burn status handler logs warning when GetTranscription() fails for duration/ETA calculation instead of using blank underscore. Backend tests pass.

name: Bug: finalizeUploadSession swallows critical DB errors
done_when: finalizeUploadSession returns error when transcription record creation fails. Caller in handlers_upload.go returns 500 to client instead of reporting upload success when transcription initialization failed. Backend tests pass.

name: Feature: Re-transcribe button shows progress box with real-time updates
done_when: When Re-transcribe is pressed on the upload/edit page, a transcription progress box appears showing real-time progress (percentage, ETA, status message) using the same polling mechanism as initial transcription. When transcription completes, the box animates closed (collapse/fade) after a brief delay. Frontend tests added. Build passes.

name: Feature: My Videos page shows real-time transcription progress for processing videos
done_when: Videos with processing status on the My Videos page show a small progress indicator (progress bar or percentage) that updates in real-time via polling. Indicator is compact (not much visual real estate). Polling stops when transcription completes and status badge updates to Complete. Frontend tests added. Build passes.

name: Feature: My Videos page larger thumbnails, less button prominence
done_when: Video thumbnails on My Videos page are significantly larger (e.g. 240px+ width or full-width on mobile). Action buttons (View, SRT, VTT, JSON, Delete) are less prominent — either smaller, moved to a secondary row, or collapsed behind a menu. Video content is the primary visual focus. Responsive on mobile. Frontend tests pass. Build passes.
